summary: A Bondi practice open seven days with implants, injectables and orthodontics is a strength, but placeholder page addresses and no named dentists appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Gum Grafting appears to link to /new-page, and the Surgical Dentistry and Smile Makeover folders appear to link to /new-dropdown-1 and /new-dropdown-2.
findings.cost: Patients clicking those items reach unfinished pages.

findings.problem: Several services appear to have two page addresses each (teeth whitening, orthodontics, implants, injectables, wisdom teeth), and Explore Invisalign appears to open the orthodontics page.
findings.cost: Duplicate pages split your Google ranking and confuse patients.
findings.fix: One page per treatment with a dedicated Invisalign page.

findings.problem: No street address appears, 'open 7 days a week' appears with no opening times, and the page title appears to say Bondi Junction while the body says Bondi.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell when or where to visit.
findings.fix: Visible address, hours and one location name.

findings.problem: No dentist is named, and no testimonials, reviews or accreditation details appear.
findings.cost: New patients want to know who will treat them and what others say.

redesign: Visible address, hours, named dentists and reviews.
